name: Statement Analyzer 6.0
notes: Protection: the app runs only after a valid unlock on the device (a copied file shows a locked screen; an ended unlock period locks the open app); buyer devices show their Device ID in the corner, with a faint watermark on the menu, About and security screens; the screen goes blank when switched away from or on Print Screen; developer-tool and save-page shortcuts are off for buyers; the code inside the lock is scrambled. Nothing changes for the owner.
